params.body:
The Gentells app lists every report in position order, so reports still to come sit between the published ones. The reports page on gentells.com splits them: first what is out (the report or a preview of it), each with its cover, then a Coming next list by title. The app cannot draw that line itself: whether the file is there is not in what it gets.

## What changes

- `/api/app/reports` gives each report `out`: `isDeliverable() || hasPreview()`, the same rule as `pages/reports.blade.php`.
- `docs/design/android-app.md`: the field.

Only the app's route changes. The agent API's `/api/v1/reports` is unchanged.

## Checked

- `AppReadsTest::test_a_report_is_out_once_its_file_or_a_preview_is_there`: a report with its file is out, one with neither file nor preview is not.
- Full suite 557/558. `BuildStampTest` fails in any worktree because the branch ref lives in the common git dir.
- Pint passes.
params.title: Say which reports are out in the app's reports list
